# ANSSI coverage

<!-- Generated by `go run ./tools/anssimatrix` from frameworks/anssi.yaml, frameworks/anssi-plan.yaml
     and the `anssi:` field of each entry. Do not edit by hand; CI fails if it is stale. -->

Directory Auditor's checks mapped to the ANSSI / CERT-FR *Points de contrôle Active Directory*
(CERTFR-2020-DUR-001, version 2024-04-17 — 76 control points). Checks are written in our own words from primary
sources; this page only maps identifiers. A point is **covered** when an entry declares it in its
`anssi:` field, **partial** when that entry covers part of it, and otherwise scheduled in a wave.

## Summary

| ANSSI level | Points | Covered | Partial | Covered + partial |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 37 | 28 | 0 | 76% |
| 2 | 18 | 16 | 0 | 89% |
| 3 | 17 | 5 | 2 | 41% |
| 4 | 4 | 1 | 0 | 25% |
| **All** | **76** | **50** | **2** | **68%** |

Remaining points by wave: wave 2 (level-1/2 needing a targeted read) 3 · wave 3 (level-3/4) 15 · wave 4 (AD CS) 6 · wave 5 (DNS) 2.
